rule: revise=true when >=2 distinct reviewers flagged the same target+issue; clear single-reviewer fixes also revised (singleReviewerFactual)
mergeDecisions: R1-4, R2-0 and R3-3 (family C-6 niece) merged as G01.
R2-1 (weather B-6 windy cued) and R3-0 (weather slot 7-8 cueing) merged as G02: one fix (no answer word shown elsewhere in its form).
R3-1 (home-rooms) and R3-2 (family) cueing are single-reviewer but the same rule as G02; applied across all three forms.

groups.issue: C-6 'nece'/niece is EVP A2 (above A1) and not parallel to A-6/B-6

flags.problem: 'niece' (nece) is EVP A2, not A1, and is harder and less frequent than the slot-6 words in forms A (husband) and B (brother). That breaks the matching note's 'all words EVP A1' and makes the forms unequal. 'nephew/niece' also appear as distractors in A-4 and B-4.
flags.fix: Use an A1 kin word with a vowel slip in C-6, e.g. 'My sistar lives in Alexandria with her husband.' -> sister.

flags.problem: The slot-6 kin word 'niece' is EVP A2, not A1, while the matching note says all words are EVP A1 and the parallel slot-5/6 words in A and B (daughter, husband, parents, brother) are all A1. Form C's error correction is harder than A and B.
flags.fix: Use an A1 kin word not shown elsewhere in form C, e.g. 'My sistar lives in Alexandria with her husband.' -> sister (spelling_vowel), and keep the rest of the sentence.

flags.problem: 'niece' is above A1 in EVP (A2/B1); the outcome is A1 and the other slot-6 words (husband, brother) are A1.
flags.fix: Use a vowel slip on an A1 kin word not keyed in form C, e.g. 'My childrin go to school near our house.' -> children.

groups.issue: in-form cueing: B-6 'windy' shown in B-3/B-7; A-7, B-7, B-8, C-7 name other items' answers

flags.problem: The correction 'windy' appears in form B before the item: B-3 lists it as an option (windy / wind / winds) and B-7 names it ('Use windy or rainy'). The slot-6 fixes in A (rainy) and C (cloudy) are not shown in their forms, so B-6 is cued and easier.
flags.fix: Keep B-6 and take 'windy' out of the rest of form B. Change B-3 to a warm/hot choice, e.g. 'Choose the correct word (warm / warmth / warms): Spring is nice here. It is ____ .' Change B-7 to 'Use sunny or rainy'. Neither cloudy (B-5) nor windy (B-6) then appears elsewhere in form B.

flags.problem: Slot 7-8 free-production prompts name words that are the keys of controlled/transfer items in the same form, so the answers are cued: A-7 'cloudy' = A-4 key; B-7 'windy'/'rainy' = B-3/B-4 keys; B-8 'hot' = B-9 key; C-7 'rainy'/'windy' = C-4 and C-9 keys.
flags.fix: Name weather words in slots 7-8 that are not keyed in the same form (e.g. A-7 windy/rainy, B-7 cloudy/cold, B-8 warm, C-7 hot/cold), or rotate the controlled keys.

groups.issue: p/b slips need a consonant-spelling enum value
groups.decision: noted (enum change = user decision; carried from round 4)

flags.problem: l1ErrorTypes = [spelling_vowel], but error-correction slots A-5 (bencil), B-5 (ben), C-5 (baper) plant a /p/-/b/ consonant substitution, not a vowel slip; only C-6 (notbook) is vowel-related.
flags.fix: Add the p/b confusion error type (e.g. spelling_p_b) to l1ErrorTypes alongside spelling_vowel.

groups.decision: noted (no enum value; user decision, carried from round 4)

flags.problem: l1ErrorTypes = [spelling_vowel], but slots A-6 (it is rain), B-6 (it is wind), C-6 (it is cloud) plant a noun used for an adjective (word-form error), which is not covered.
flags.fix: Add a word-form / noun-for-adjective error type to l1ErrorTypes, or make slot 6 a vowel slip as well.

groups.issue: B-5 'cooking room' not a real Arabic calque; B-6 contrived double error; l1ErrorTypes empty
groups.decision: revise items (B-5 eating room, B-6 path room); l1_calque/spelling_p_b enum = user decision (single-reviewer)

flags.problem: B-5 'Our cooking room has a big window.' is not a realistic Arabic-L1 error: Arabic has a single word for kitchen (matbakh), so there is no calque for 'cooking room', unlike sleeping room (ghurfat al-nawm) or eating room (ghurfat al-ta'am). B-6 'The guests sit in the sitting room of guests' is a contrived double error, and its key accepts 'sitting room', so the only fix is deleting 'of guests'. outcomes.json l1ErrorTypes for home-rooms is [] even though the forms plant calques and the p/b slip (C-5 'path room').
flags.fix: Replace B-5 with a real calque or p/b slip (e.g. 'The bath room is next to the kitchen' -> 'path room', or 'The guests room is big' -> 'living room'). Rewrite B-6 as a single natural error (e.g. 'We sit in the guests room after dinner' -> living room). Set l1ErrorTypes to [l1_calque, spelling_p_b].

flags.problem: The prompt says 'Two words', but acceptedAnswers include 'lounge' (one word) and 'living-room' (hyphenated), so the instruction and the key disagree.
flags.fix: Change the prompt to 'One or two words', or remove 'lounge' from acceptedAnswers.

flags.problem: The text is 'It's warm and ____', and the key accepts 'hot', which makes 'warm and hot' (contradictory or redundant).

groups.issue: in-form cueing in slots 7-8 and C-3 options

flags.problem: Same-form cueing: A-7 'kitchen' = A-1/A-9 key; A-8 'bedroom' = A-5 correction (also A-3 option); B-7 'bathroom' = B-3/B-9 keys; B-8 'living room' = B-6 key; C-7 'garden' = C-4 key; C-3 options show 'bathroom'/'bedroom', the C-5/C-6 corrections.
flags.fix: Choose named rooms in slots 7-8 that are not keyed/corrected in the same form, and avoid showing the slot 5-6 correction as a slot 3-4 option.

groups.issue: in-form cueing in slot 8 / C-3 options

flags.problem: Same-form cueing: A-8 'cousin' = A-2 key; B-8 'uncle' = B-4 key; C-8 'aunt' = C-4 key (C-7 'brother' is also a C-3 option).
flags.fix: Name kin words in slots 7-8 that are not keyed in the same form (e.g. A-8 uncle, B-8 aunt, C-8 cousin).

flags.problem: 'pharmacist' is likely above A2 in EVP (B1), unlike dentist/engineer in B-6/C-6.
flags.fix: Verify EVP level; if B1, use an i/e slip on an A2 job noun not in form A, e.g. 'artest' -> artist.

groups.issue: slot 5-6 corrections repeat slot 1-2 keys (low severity)
groups.decision: noted (low severity: corrections are not shown to the learner, so no cueing; resampling would re-balance spelling difficulty set in round 4)

flags.problem: Each slot 5-6 correction repeats a slot 1-2 gap-fill key in the same form (A: February/Tuesday; B: August/Wednesday; C: September/Thursday), so a form samples only ~4 distinct words and one spelling weakness is double-counted.
flags.fix: Make slot 5-6 words differ from slot 1-2 keys (e.g. A-1 key Thursday, B-2 key December), keeping spelling difficulty matched.
